title: 填写
summary: 「做个表单」只说了有格子。先定填写前、填写中、提交后这一栏该交代什么：标签常在、必填先标、错在栏下能改、成功带下一步。
summaryEn: “Make a form” only says there are boxes. First decide what this field discloses before, during, and after: a lasting label, required up front, a field-level fix, and a success with a next step.
asks: 填写前、填写中、提交后，这一栏该交代什么？
asksEn: What should this field disclose before filling, while filling, and after submit?

links.when: 三个时刻该交代什么不是填还是选
links.whenEn: what the three moments disclose is not fill versus pick

links.when: 若问题是错误何时开口
links.whenEn: if the miss is when the error should speak

links.when: 当场能改不是何时开口
links.whenEn: a field-level fix is not when the error speaks

links.when: 提交成功不是一条 toast
links.whenEn: a completed submit is not a toast
